question: Where are a City of Phoenix house's permits, and how do I search them without missing records or misreading a status?
verdictConfirmed: 2026-11-23 browser: both PDD Online and the SHAPE PHX Data/Reports search return records for an address with no account.
demand: Bing market counts, capture 2026-11-23-demand-phoenix-permit-search-bing (relative only): 'city of phoenix permit search' recorded; this site has no Phoenix page and no Phoenix impressions. No volume is stated on the page.

observations: PDD Online Permit Information Search (apps-secure.phoenix.gov/PDD/Search/Permits), 2026-11-23, no account: By Address with number 200, direction W, street WASHINGTON, type ST (City Hall, 200 W Washington St).

The Start Date and End Date boxes sit inside the 'By Solar\Green\Adaptive Re-use' section and arrived pre-filled 10/24/2026 to 11/23/2026 (30 days). Left as they were, the address search still returned 1 - 10 of 915 items, so the dates did not limit an address search.
Sorted by issued date, the oldest record was OSME-93023180, issued 12/06/1993, status EXPR.
Status values seen on the first page: EXPR, DONE, VOID.

OE-94023192 (issued 11/07/1994, status EXPR, electrical contractor named) Inspection History: 399 FINAL/ELECTRICAL NO ACCESS 08/06/1996; FAIL 09/19/1996; 311 RESEARCH NON-INSP ACTIVITY CONCLUDED 09/23/1996; 399 FINAL/ELECTRICAL PASS 10/09/1996. An EXPR status sat on a permit whose final inspection passed.
ELEC-94011014 (EXPR) Inspection History showed no items, so an empty history is possible too.
'Show temps?' defaults to No; Yes adds temporary/unissued permits.

SHAPE PHX (shapephx.phoenix.gov) DATA / REPORTS, category Permit, no login: address number 200, street WASHINGTON returned 647 Results Returned. Results included 2002 W WASHINGTON ST, so the number box matched a longer house number. Records with issued dates 2019-11-25, 2019-11-20, 2020-01-14 were present, with status 'Permit Expired'. Several City Hall results were 'New Standard Home from Standard Plan' records, which is a feature of using City Hall as the test address, not of a house.
Screenshot public/images/phoenix-pdd-expired-permit-passed-final.webp: OE-94023192's inspection history, inspector and data-entry names removed by us.
computations: Phoenix city holds 653,065 of Maricopa County's 1,884,334 housing units = 34.7%.

facts.claim: PDD Online permit search allows wildcard and address search; no log on is needed to search.
facts.quote: A wildcard search character (*) may be used to replace any character in the search field. By Address (can use wildcard in number and street)
Clicking 'Yes' will include temporary/unissued permits in the results along with the issued permits.

facts.claim: SHAPE PHX search holds records entered from June 6, 2022; older records are in PDD Online.
facts.quote: The search is limited to Shape PHX records entered as of June 6, 2022. If you need to search older records, please go to PDD Online

facts.claim: SHAPE PHX search shows at most 50,000 records.
facts.quote: Search results will show the first 50,000 records.

facts.claim: From April 27, 2026, new single-family residential permits and inspections are in SHAPE PHX.
facts.quote: Effective April 27, 2026 - You can now visit the SHAPE PHX portal for access to NEW Commercial Plan Review and Inspections permits: Commercial Plan Review Commercial Permitting and Inspections Single-family Residential Permits and Inspections

facts.claim: Arizona law opens public records to inspection by any person during office hours.
facts.quote: Public records and other matters in the custody of any officer shall be open to inspection by any person at all times during office hours.

cut: Any claim about Phoenix mailing addresses outside city limits: no primary source read today, so the page only says the city search holds City of Phoenix permits and points to the county guide.
Any statement that PDD Online starts in a given year: the 1993 record is the oldest at one test address, not a system start date.
Meaning of EXPR/DONE/VOID: no city legend found; the page reports what the records show, not a definition.
